Verdict: Pass for artifact-07ee5da0-f944-4ae7-8f75-7d46a00cf14b, revision 1, limited to the README B1 correction and removal of that documentation blocker to limited delivery.

Reviewer: standalone QA instance qa-8f106e04-fe92-4ff1-9945-3f161b4cba93. Governing basis: SoloCo v0.21 and team_sha256 7dc8081a08646135a7e021f1651eb3ac2952af9f63cf48ed0418efdcab8695b3. Review used supplied text only. No tools, commands, external access, file changes, tests or hash recomputation occurred.

The revised README replaces the unsupported prevention claim with: “The utility penalizes estimated immediate king loss heavily relative to bounded continuation value. This is a heuristic preference, not a survival guarantee; model error, sampling and the prior can still lead to fatal choices.” This directly satisfies B1's clearing condition. It describes an estimated-loss preference without asserting survival-first dominance or guaranteed behavior. The adjacent disclosures concerning approximate beliefs, model limitations and strategy fusion are consistent with the supplied source reviews.

The supplied host verification reports unchanged runtime members, submission ZIP and original evaluation evidence, and two passing static checks after the README correction. The listed runtime and ZIP hashes match those in the prior final review. These are supplied bindings and host-reported execution evidence, not independently recomputed identities or tests executed by this reviewer. No new games or runtime repairs are required by this documentation finding.

Delivery disposition: The exact corrected README and unchanged locally qualified package may proceed to receiver acceptance and delivery to the existing founder-authorized private yimoburu/fog-of-war-bot repository under the supplied standing authority. This verdict clears the sole documentation blocker; it creates no execution authority and attests neither a repository head nor completed publication.

Preserved limits: The local result remains 261 wins, eight draws and 131 losses, or 265/400 points (66.25%), against released v2 with 600 ms versus 180 ms internal budgets and equal 180+2 clocks on a shared host. The reported interval 55.31%–77.19% remains conditional on independent bounded pair outcomes. This review relies on the prior independent reconciliation of the 200 pairs and does not repeat it. No compute-matched or algorithm-only superiority, survival guarantee, MIT Elo, Linux arena qualification, native execution or company_develop acceptance is established.

Historical disposition: Preserve the original Fail in artifact-2b07c45d-7ebf-4853-94da-3c9d93a886de and original final evidence unchanged. Record this as supplemental B1 closure, retaining all earlier failures, numerical warnings and limitations. The unresolved cancellation notice remains unresolved; this review neither acknowledges it for the founder nor changes its disposition.

Receiver: runner/Chief of Staff. Record acceptance against these exact bindings, append this supplemental disposition without rewriting raw evidence, and complete only the already authorized limited delivery.

review.reason: The exact revised README removes the unsupported king-survival prevention claim and explicitly describes a heuristic estimated-loss preference with model, sampling, prior and fatal-choice limitations, satisfying the sole B1 clearing condition. Supplied host verification reports unchanged runtime, ZIP and original evidence, with hashes matching the prior final review and two static checks passing. This clears the documentation blocker for receiver acceptance and limited delivery under existing authority only; historical Fail verdicts, host-evidence limitations and all statistical and arena qualifications remain intact.
